title: Beh raha hai khoon ka
body:
Beh raha hai khoon ka
<<MINI>>
(Haay haay hussain) x2
(Behraha he khun ka darya laashaye shabbir se) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. (Paani paani ki sadaa) x2 aati he zakhme teer se
<<MINI>>
(Behraha he khun ka darya laashaye shabbir se) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. (lashaye akber paraa he khun me dubaa huwa) x2
(kehdo wapaas lot jaye) x2 kaside hamsheer se
<<MINI>>
Behraha he khun ka darya laashaye shabbir se
(Haay haay hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
3. (karbala ke dasht me tha jurm paani mangna) x2
(hogaya khamosh asgher) x2 hurmula ke teer se
<<MINI>>
Behraha he khun ka darya laashaye shabbir se
(Haay haay hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
4. (jiske bose leke milta tha muhammed ko sukoon) x2
(wo gulu kataa gaya hai) x2 aaj khund shamsheer se
<<MINI>>
Behraha he khun ka darya laashaye shabbir se
(Haay haay hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
5. (sar bareh na ho gayi he lut gayi he chadare) x2
(jinko dhampa tha nabine) x2 chaadre tathir se
<<MINI>>
Behraha he khun ka darya laashaye shabbir se
(Haay haay hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. (shaam me jawongi nange sar mere marne ke baad) x2
(hoke rukhsat keh rahe the) x2 shaahe din hamsheer se
<<MINI>>
Behraha he khun ka darya laashaye shabbir se
(Haay haay hussain) x2
